The '''Sunwolf speeder bike''' was [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno's]] military variant of their popular [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bike]].

==Description==
Measuring 2.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], the Sunwolf was an improved, military-grade version of the [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bike]]. Capable of speeds up to 425 [[Kilometer/Legends|km]][[Standard hour/Legends|h]] with a flight ceiling of 15 meters, the Sunwolf was a single-seat [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] armed with a single forward-facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. A Sunwolf cost 5,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] when purchased new, and 1,150 when used.<ref name="CRO-10" />

==History==
The Sunwolf was [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno's]] first foray in the military speeder bike market, and was an improved version of their civilian model, the Starhawk. While not as fast or powerful as [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech's]] [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], the Sunwolf was popular with [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments and mercenaries as it was cheaper to buy.<ref name="CRO-10" />

As the Sunwolf looked almost identical to the Starhawk, the bike was favored by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents and other like-minded individuals as it was often mistaken for its civilian predecessor, which gave them the element of surprise in some situations. [[Thilis-Brin]], an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Foster Agent]] working for the Alliance, drove a modified version of the Sunwolf as her personal vehicle.<ref name="CRO-10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sunwolf speeder bike was first mentioned in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]], published by [[West End Games]] in [[1996]].
